risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (299.68) indicates extreme market stress, though falling DXY provides modest relief for multinationals and earnings binary is distant (112 days).

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with multiple bullish MACD crossovers and Hull flip confirmation provides technical setup, while extreme market fear (31/100) and inverted yield curve create contrarian opportunity for patient accumulation.
debate.key_bear_argument: RSI-9 overbought at 70.95, StochRSI overbought, weak ADX trend strength (14.54), zero fundamental momentum, no insider conviction, high earnings risk in 112 days, and macro crisis conditions (VIX 299.68, inverted yield curve) create pullback risk that outweighs technical setup.
